title: Mockery Manor
subtitle: Murder, twins, and black comedy inside a dangerously cheerful theme park.
description: Summer, 1989, somewhere in deepest darkest England. Mockery Manor is a theme park where people disappear, and it's up to a pair of chaotic teenage twins to catch a killer. British Podcast Awards 'Best Fiction' Nominee 2020. If you like Widow's Bay, Hot Fuzz , and Only Murders In The Building , then Mockery Manor is for you. Mockery Manor is a full-cast production best enjoyed using headphones.
